brief: JPM's Sept 21 afternoon briefing frames a risk-on session (SPX +1.5%, NDX +2.8%, RTY +0.5%) driven by Meta's Muse app launch, which lifted META 12% and revived CPU-intensive AI-compute demand, pushing AMD, INTC and ARM higher while "AI Vulnerable" tax-loss names (NFLX, CPNG, APP) reverted. WTI fell nearly 5% after Trump called off Houthi airstrikes and diplomatic hopes rose ahead of the UN GA, pulling the 10Y yield down alongside it. Separately, Fedspeak from Goolsbee and Musalem was hawkish, echoing Warsh's press conference and raising the risk of an additional hike versus forecasts. JPM stays Tactically Cautious/Neutral into the Fed, citing unstabilized energy prices, elevated bond volatility (10Y near 5%) and directionless positioning. It would turn bullish on lower oil/yields or a US-Iran deal, bearish if the consumer breaks or an AI capex cut ends the AI theme. Its Monetization Menu keeps +Tech vs -RTY (dollar/market-neutral) given early-hiking-cycle USD strength and curve flattening, while flagging Latam as a non-AI hedge.
